# Judith Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 7 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_007_page_001.jpg

---

**7:1** And on the-next day Holofernes commanded all his-army and all the-people who-had-come to-him as allies to-strike-camp against Bethulia and to-seize in-advance the-ascents of-the hill-country and to-make-war on the-sons of Israel.

**7:2** And every man of-might among-them struck-camp in that day. And the-force of their-armies was a hundred and seventy thousand foot-soldiers and twelve thousand horsemen, besides the-baggage and the-men on-foot among them — an exceedingly great multitude.

**7:3** And they-camped in-the valley near Bethulia, by the-spring, and they-spread out in breadth over Dothaim as-far-as Belmaim and in-length from Bethulia to Cyamon, which is opposite Esdraelon.

**7:4** And the-sons of Israel, when they-saw their-multitude, were-greatly-dismayed and said, one-to-another: "Now these will-lick-clean the-face of all the-land, and neither the-high mountains nor the-valleys nor the-hills will-bear the-weight of their-force."

**7:5** And every man took-up his-weapons of-war and they-lit signal-fires on their-towers, and they-continued-on-watch all that-night.

**7:6** On the-second day Holofernes led-out all his-cavalry before the-sons of Israel who-were in Bethulia,

**7:7** and he-surveyed the-ascents of their-city and he-searched-out the-springs of-their-water and he-seized them and set-over-them guards of-soldiers and he-himself returned to his-people.

**7:8** And all the-chiefs of-the sons of Esau and all the-leaders of-the people of Moab and the-generals of-the coastal-region came to-him and said:

**7:9** "Let our-lord now hear a-word, lest there-be a-defeat for his-army.

**7:10** For this people of-the sons of Israel do not trust in their-spears but in-the height of-the mountains where they-dwell — for it is not easy to-ascend the-peaks of their-mountains.

**7:11** Therefore, lord, do not fight against them in-battle-formation, and not one man of your-people will-fall.

**7:12** Remain in your-camp and guard every man of your-army, and let your-servants hold-in-possession the-spring of-water that-issues from-the-foot of-the mountain —

**7:13** because from there all the-inhabitants of Bethulia draw their-water. And thirst will-destroy them and they-will-give-up their-city. And we and our-people will-go-up onto the-summits of the-nearby mountains and encamp upon them, to-keep-watch that not one man goes-out from-the city.

**7:14** And they-will-waste-away by hunger — they and their-wives and their-children — and before the-sword comes-upon them they-will-be-laid-low in-the streets where they-dwell.

**7:15** And you will-repay them with evil because they-rebelled and did not receive you with-peace."

**7:16** And their-words were-pleasing in-the-sight of Holofernes and in-the-sight of all his-attendants, and he-gave orders to-do as-they-had-spoken.

**7:17** And the-camp of-the sons of Ammon moved, and with them five thousand of-the sons of Assyria, and they-encamped in-the valley and they-seized the-waters and the-springs of-the waters of-the sons of Israel.

**7:18** And the-sons of Esau went-up and the-sons of Ammon and encamped in-the hill-country opposite Dothan. And they-sent some of-them toward the-south and toward the-east, opposite Egrebel, which is near Chous, which is upon the-stream Mochmur. And the-rest of-the Assyrian army encamped in-the plain and covered all the-face of-the land. And their-tents and their-baggage made-camp in a great crowd, and they-were a very great multitude.

**7:19** And the-sons of Israel cried-out to-the Lord their-God, for their-spirit-sank, because all their-enemies had-surrounded them and there-was no-way-of-escape from-their-midst.

**7:20** And all-the army of Assyria remained around them, their-foot-soldiers and their-chariots and their-cavalry, for thirty-four days. And all the-containers of-water of all the-inhabitants of Bethulia gave-out,

**7:21** and the-cisterns were-becoming-empty and they-did-not have enough water to-drink to-satisfy [themselves] for even a day, for they-were-measured-out as-a-ration for drinking.

**7:22** And their-children were-dispirited and the-women and the-young-men fainted from-thirst and they-were-falling-down in-the streets of-the city and in-the passages of-the gates, and there-was no-longer any strength in them.

**7:23** And all the-people were-assembled against Uzziah and the-rulers of-the city, the-young-men and the-women and the-children, and they-cried-out with a great voice and said before all the-elders:

**7:24** "May God judge between us and you, for you-have-done us great harm in not seeking-peace with the-sons of Assyria.

**7:25** And now there-is no-one helping us — God has-sold us into their-hands so-that we-should-lie-fallen before them in-thirst and great-destruction.

**7:26** And now call them out and give-over the-whole-city as-plunder to the-people of Holofernes and to all his-force.

**7:27** For it is-better for us to-become plunder for them. For we-will-be slaves, but our-souls will-live, and we-will-not see the-death of our-infants before our-eyes, nor the-dying of our-wives and our-children.

**7:28** We-call-to-witness against you heaven and earth and our-God and the-Lord of our-fathers, who punishes us according-to our-sins and the-sins of our-fathers — that he-should-not do this thing today."

**7:29** And there-was great weeping of-all as-one in-the-midst of-the assembly, and they-cried-out to-the Lord God with a great voice.

**7:30** And Uzziah said to them: "Take-courage, brothers, let-us-hold-out yet five more days, during which the-Lord our-God will-turn his-mercy upon us, for he-will-not forsake us completely.

**7:31** But if these days pass and no-help comes to us, I-will-do according-to your-words."

**7:32** And he-dismissed the-people, each man to his-own-camp, and they-went-away to-the walls and the-towers of-the city. And the-women and the-children he-sent to their-houses. And they-were-brought-very-low in-the city.
